name: 8' Fabric Pop Up Display (Straight)
descriptionHtml:
8' straight pop up design    Hardcase . 

 Features:

Your artwork will be dye sublimated on polyester knit
Graphic panel covers the front and two sides of the display's frame; the back of the frame is not covered
Hook-and-loop fasteners make it easy to install graphic panels
Lightweight aluminum frame with nylon plastic hubs
Imprint Method: Full-Color Dye Sublimation
Single Sided Graphic

8ft fabric pop up Includes:

  • (1) Single-Sided Dye-Sublimated Graphic (with Endcaps)
  • (1) Aluminum Frame
  • (1) Black Nylon Carry Bag
  • Display Size:89"W x 89"H x 12"D
  • Size:114"W x 88.5"H
  • Endcaps:11.81" end panels on both sides)
  • Material:Stretch Fabric
  • Shipping Dimensions:12"L x 12"W x 35"H
  • Shipping Weight:24 lbs
